context: This evaluation assesses proficiency in using the @json-render/core and @json-render/react packages to build dashboard configurations with advanced features including complex visibility conditions, action workflows with confirmation dialogs, conditional validation, and data binding.

checklist.name: Catalog Creation
checklist.description: Uses createCatalog() from @json-render/core to define components with Zod schemas and hasChildren flags, and declares available actions

checklist.name: Complex Visibility Logic
checklist.description: Implements visibility conditions using nested logic expressions (and, or, not operators), comparison operators (eq, gt), path-based conditions ({ path: '...' }), and auth conditions ({ auth: 'signedIn' })

checklist.name: Action Confirmation Dialogs
checklist.description: Defines actions with confirm property containing title, message with string interpolation (e.g., '${/order/amount}'), and variant for dialog styling

checklist.name: Action Success Callbacks
checklist.description: Implements onSuccess callbacks that update data paths using set property (e.g., { set: { '/order/status': 'refunded' } })

checklist.name: Action Error Callbacks
checklist.description: Implements onError callbacks that capture and display error messages using $error.message token (e.g., { set: { '/ui/errorMessage': '$error.message' } })

checklist.name: Validation Checks
checklist.description: Configures validation checks array with built-in validation functions (required, minLength) including fn, args, and message properties

checklist.name: Conditional Validation
checklist.description: Uses enabled property on validation config with logic expressions to make validation conditional based on data path values

checklist.name: Data Path Binding
checklist.description: Uses DynamicValue pattern with { path: '...' } syntax to bind component properties to data model paths (e.g., valuePath, or dynamic props)

checklist.name: Component Registry
checklist.description: Creates component registry mapping component types to React components that accept element, children, and onAction props from @json-render/react
